body: An open-source desktop app for local LLMs with text, vision, tool calling, and API access.
plain_description: **Run a private AI assistant on your own computer.** Chat with local models, use them through an API, and work with documents, images, and custom tools. Fine-tuning and image generation are also available.
technical_description: TextGen is an open-source desktop app and browser-based web UI for running local language models. It supports GGUF models and multiple backends, including llama.cpp, Transformers, ExLlamaV3, and TensorRT-LLM. Features include chat, image input, document attachments, tool calling, an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, LoRA fine-tuning, and image generation. The README states the app works offline and has no telemetry.
title: TextGen
